停牌已近三个月的微创医疗（00853.HK），11月23日披露了香港联交所对其复牌提出的完整指引。

　　这份指引把独立法证调查的范围，从公司此前提及的物业租赁协议，扩大至“求真务实基金有限公司与本集团或常兆华博士（常博士）家人之间于长期内进行的多宗交易”，并要求证明管理层及相关人士的诚信、能力及品格并无合理的监管疑虑。

　　根据公告，联交所列出了六项复牌指引，覆盖核查交易、人员、内控、财报等多个层面。

　　其中，第一条列明的核查对象较为具体：要求就微创医疗与上海回青橙投资管理有限公司（作为业主）就上海的一间工业厂房所签订的租赁协议、求真务实基金有限公司与本集团或常兆华博士家人之间于长期内进行的多宗交易，以及任何其他引起类似疑虑的交易或安排进行适当的独立法证调查，评估对本公司业务营运及财务状况的影响，公布调查结果，并采取适当的补救措施。

　　此外，第二项要求公司证明管理层及／或对管理及营运具有重大影响的任何人士（尤其是常博士）的诚信、能力及／或品格并无合理的监管疑虑。第三项要求委聘独立内部控制顾问进行独立内部控制检讨，证明与暂停买卖相关的已识别重大缺陷已被纠正，且所有必要的补救措施已获实施，及公司的内部控制足够及有效，并使公司能遵守上市规则及其他法律及监管规定。其余三项分别要求刊发所有尚未刊发的财务业绩并处理审核修订、证明符合上市规则第13.24条、将所有重大资料告知市场。

　　回顾事件脉络，微创医疗、微创机器人（02252.HK）、微创心通（02160.HK）、微创脑科学（02172.HK）四家“微创系”港股公司于9月1日起集体停牌，股份及债务证券同步暂停买卖，原因是无法按期刊发2026年中期业绩。

　　在延期公告中，公司列出的待办事项主要是租赁条款与保证金安排继续磋商、重新评估保证金可收回性与装修成本合理性、重新审阅集团与物业业主及其联系人的关系。

　　涉事租约签订于2021年5月，据微创医疗公告，公司及附属公司承租张东路1661号约12.64万平方米工业及研发物业，五年总租金约1.95亿美元、折合人民币约12.58亿元，并须支付相当于一年至两年租金的保证金。

　　截至8月20日，11家承租主体中3家附属公司完成续租、8家仍在磋商，存放于出租方的保证金余额约2.96亿元。

　　此后常兆华先后辞任微创医疗执行董事、董事会主席及微创机器人董事长及非执行董事，常洋在出任微创心通董事会主席两个月后辞任，人事变动与租约风波的时间重叠引发市场关注。

　　目前，微创医疗的股票交易将继续暂停。时间表方面，联交所要求公司必须在11月30日或之前公布首个季度更新，内容包括其业务营运、其复牌计划（附带各工作阶段的时间表）、实施复牌计划的进展及复牌计划任何重大变动的详情。之后每三个月公布一次，直至恢复买卖或其上市地位被取消为止。公告还提醒，联交所可将已连续18个月暂停买卖的任何证券除牌。

英伟达恢复黄仁勋总裁兼首席执行官职务、并立即生效后，人工智能相关公司的股价大涨。

　　他说：“不过，数据中心延期以及企业客户对定价的抵触并没有消失。因此，核心问题并没有改变。也正因为如此，从长期来看，这未必就是多头一直在等待的那个催化剂。”

　　Interactive Brokers首席策略师Steve Sosnick表示：“董事会似乎是在市场和政府的压力下让步了。这将安抚英伟达股东，甚至整个市场。但等新一届国会就位后，围绕黄仁勋、卢特尼克等人的一系列国会调查恐怕会接踵而至。”

专题：英伟达官宣恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO及董事会职务

　　核心要点

title: Z.ai 发布 7500 亿参数旗舰模型 GLM-5.4，跟随 OpenAI 布局循环 Transformer 架构
originalTitle: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
author: Jonathan Kemper
summary: Z.ai 发布旗舰模型 GLM-5.4，将 7500 亿参数模型迁移至循环架构，让 28 层网络运行两次。公司称该设计能让其匹敌 2 至 3 万亿参数的模型，但目前基准成绩仅来自较小的 30B 测试模型。Z.ai 将 GLM-5.4 定位为"泛化编码"（Generalized Coding）的开端，代码还可生成视频、游戏和 CAD 模型。
context: 循环 Transformer 是 OpenAI 也在走的路线，Z.ai 以更少参数对标更大模型的策略值得行业关注。
contentHtml:
Z.ai is moving its flagship model to a loop architecture that runs some of its layers twice. With GLM-5.4, the company wants to mark the start of "Generalized Coding," where code also generates videos, games, and CAD models.

Following OpenAI, Z.ai is introducing GLM-5.4, its first large model built on a loop transformer. While standard language models use each layer once per pass, GLM-5.4 runs a block of shared layers multiple times, refining the intermediate results from the previous pass to make the network deeper without adding parameters. OpenAI has used a similar architecture since GPT-6 Astra. According to Z.ai, the 750-billion-parameter model reaches performance comparable to models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters.

The team retrained the GLM-5 base model released in February into a loop model that runs 28 layers twice. Loop models trained from scratch have so far performed worse than models without shared weights under the same compute budget, Z.ai writes.

Gates and shared caching keep the second pass manageable

Converting the model introduces a problem, Z.ai says. If the model simply overwrites intermediate states on each pass, activations grow sharply from round to round, leaving subsequent layers with values outside the range they were trained on.

To handle this, GLM-5.4 uses dedicated gates for each token and pass to control how much of the new output flows back into the data stream. According to Z.ai, the model builds context cautiously on the first pass and writes its changes back in full on the second. On difficult tokens, Z.ai says, the first pass steps in more strongly.

Because the second pass would otherwise double memory usage, both passes share the KV cache, the temporary memory for previously processed tokens. The second pass stores its own extra values only in a small local window. As a result, Z.ai says, the overhead compared to GLM-5.3 stays manageable even at a 1-million-token context.

To save on compute as well, the model uses sparse attention to pick the most relevant earlier tokens upfront rather than scanning the entire context every time, a standard technique. The second pass then reuses that selection from the first instead of making a new one. According to Z.ai, that yields nearly the same results as picking tokens separately on each pass. The company also says the model reaches up to 200 tokens per second off-peak and 70 to 80 tokens per second under load.

A looped 30B test model beats its baseline with shorter reasoning chains

Before rolling out the architecture in its flagship, Z.ai tested it on models with 1, 4, 30, and 750 billion parameters. For a direct comparison, the team used a 30B model built on the same architecture as the large base model. Both versions had the same parameter count, while the loop version received about 10 percent more training compute. Its biggest gain came on the AIME25 math benchmark, where scores jumped from 19.2 to 30.4 points. Scores on the expert-level science questions in GPQA-Diamond rose from 47.6 to 56.3 points, and on the AA-LCR long-context test they climbed from 40.3 to 47.7 points. Gains were smaller at just over three points on the MMLU-Pro knowledge test and on IFBench, which tests instruction following.

Responses also got shorter, shrinking 14.9 percent on MMLU-Pro, 11.7 percent on GPQA-Diamond, and just 2 percent on AIME25. Z.ai says part of the reasoning shifts out of the output tokens and into the loop's extra computational depth.

It is still impossible to judge how well GLM-5.4 actually performs, as Z.ai has published no benchmark scores for the 750B model and the figures in its blog post come solely from the 30B test. There are no independent evaluations from groups like Artificial Analysis either.

By Z.ai's own account, GLM-5.4's biggest weakness is overly long reasoning phases in which the model gets stuck, though the company says that extended double-checking improves accuracy.

Z.ai views GLM-5.4 as the starting point for "Generalized Coding," where the company says code becomes the foundation for tasks beyond traditional software development. To illustrate the idea, Z.ai shows a music video scored by the model itself, a six-axis robot arm it says GLM-5.4 designed in FreeCAD, a complete game, and an interactive 3D scene built from mathematical geometry and custom shaders.

1 / 4

Z.ai plans to release model weights and a much larger model

GLM-5.4 is available through the GLM Coding Plan, the ZCode coding environment, and Z.ai Chat, with an API set to follow and token pricing not yet announced. Z.ai plans to release the model weights after further safety testing, and it also announced a much larger model expected to arrive soon.

Shared layers date back to the Universal Transformer in 2018. In March, researchers in Bonn showed that looped transformers benefit from greater compute depth on math, while everyday knowledge benefits more from greater memory, the same trade-off Z.ai cites to explain its architecture. Thinking Machines also drew attention recently with Inkling 2 Mini because the loop model runs locally on Macs with at least 32 GB of RAM.

At 750 billion parameters, GLM-5.4 is nowhere near running on a laptop, but Z.ai is instead targeting the tier of Kimi K3.1 Pro and Qwen3.8-Max. At 2.8 trillion and 2.4 trillion parameters, respectively, those models are more than three times as large and require large amounts of compute.

For its predecessor GLM-5.3, Z.ai kept the existing base model and drew all of its gains from post-training. The company delayed releasing its weights because of the model's strong vulnerability-finding abilities, and Anthropic later found that GLM-5.3 could build exploits on its own, almost on par with Claude Mythos Preview.

title: 黄仁勋时隔12天重回英伟达CEO宝座 苹果乔布斯当年等了12年
originalTitle: 黄仁勋时隔12天重回英伟达CEO宝座 苹果乔布斯等了12年
summary: 英伟达董事会仅用12天就撤销罢免黄仁勋的决定，黄仁勋重回CEO职位。作为对照，苹果乔布斯当年重返CEO等了12年，而三年前的同一周，OpenAI撤换山姆·奥特曼后不到五天就完成了同样的复位。
source: 新浪财经 · 实时滚动
context: 董事会12天推翻罢免决定，与乔布斯12年、奥特曼5天的回归速度形成鲜明对比，凸显科技巨头治理波动对市场的冲击。
contentHtml:
作者：Jared Blikre

　　英伟达董事会只用了 12 天，就做出撤销罢免黄仁勋的决定。三年前的同一周，OpenAI 撤换山姆・奥特曼，完成同样的复位只用了不到五天。

　　几乎没人预料到黄仁勋复职的消息。周一早晨，就在英伟达发布官方复职公告的几分钟之前，预测市场 Polymarket 上，押注黄仁勋本月复职的概率仅约 3%。公告发布五分钟后，该概率飙升至 99%。

　　董事会全票通过决议，即刻恢复黄仁勋总裁、首席执行官以及董事职务，科莱特・克雷斯回归首席财务官岗位。董事会主席哈维・琼斯表示：“董事会认为，黄仁勋是领导英伟达的合适人选。” 英伟达股价暴涨超 30%。

　　黄仁勋的短暂下台代价惨重

　　从 11 月 11 日收盘（董事会接受黄仁勋辞职）至上周五，英伟达市值蒸发约 1.2 万亿美元，这期间还出现英伟达老款 GPU 价格逆势走高的现象。

　　硅谷之前就上演过相似戏码。2023 年 11 月一个周五下午，OpenAI 解雇奥特曼；周日微软向他抛出橄榄枝；OpenAI 约 770 名员工当中，超过 700 人威胁跟随他离职。到周二晚间，奥特曼重回 OpenAI。

　　奥特曼在 X 平台发文：“我热爱 OpenAI，过去几天我所做的一切，都是为了保全这个团队与我们的使命。”

　　虽然并非由本人发起，但民间也出现声援黄仁勋的浪潮。一份名为 “与黄仁勋站在一起” 的请愿书收集超 10 万签名，埃隆・马斯克也参与签名，其中有 5000 多份签名自称来自英伟达内部员工。请愿呼吁 “遵循正当程序，而非暴民式审判”。

　　当初促成奥特曼回归的关键力量是微软；而推动黄仁勋复职的是美国白宫。

　　董事会表示，美国政府高层给出意见，据此判定黄仁勋不存在国家安全风险，这成为他获得二次机会的关键。

　　但黄仁勋的回归和奥特曼有一处不同：奥特曼回来时，董事会已经完成大换血；黄仁勋面对的还是原班董事会，同时新增设立国家安全与出口控制委员会、启动首席合规官的招聘，还要接受针对 “遭境外情报机构盯上” 相关报道的独立调查。

　　乔布斯回归苹果耗费 12 年

　　史蒂夫・乔布斯 1985 年 9 月离开苹果，1997 年 9 月才回归担任临时 CEO。他回归首日，苹果股价上涨 2%；之后一年，苹果股价跑赢标普 500 指数，超额收益达到 65 个百分点。

　　大多数知名的创始人回归，开局都会获得华尔街一片叫好，但往后一年的表现却是好坏参半。英伟达本次盘前 30% 的涨幅，是下文统计图表里，其他几位 CEO 回归首日最大涨幅的三倍有余。

　　学术研究：“归位型 CEO” 的实际表现并不乐观

　　麻省理工斯隆管理学院的一项研究，统计 1992‑2017 年间标普 1500 成分股公司的 167 位重新上任的 CEO。研究发现，这类 CEO 任职期间，公司股价年均表现，要比首任 CEO 执掌时期低大约 10%；在技术迭代飞快的行业，差距会更大。 样本中，创始人 CEO 占全部 CEO 的 4%，但在 “归位复职 CEO” 群体里占比高达 44%。

　　黄仁勋接下来日程依旧紧张：12 月 1 日要参加众议院闭门问询，并且已经同意出席参议院银行委员会的公开听证会。

　　乔布斯后来把自己当年被赶出苹果的经历视作一份馈赠。

　　他在 2005 年斯坦福大学毕业演讲中说道：“我当时并未意识到，但事后证明，被苹果解雇，是发生在我身上最好的一件事。”

title: Sierra 完成 17.5 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值半年翻倍至 300 亿美元
originalTitle: Sierra doubles valuation to $30B within six months as demand for AI in CX takes off
author: Ivan Mehta
summary: 由前 Salesforce 联合 CEO Bret Taylor 联合创办的企业级客户体验公司 Sierra 周一宣布完成 17.5 亿美元 F 轮融资，估值在半年内翻倍至 300 亿美元。融资之际，市场对 AI 在客户体验领域应用的需求正快速升温。
context: 半年估值翻倍是 AI 应用层标志性融资事件，凸显企业级 AI 客服赛道的资本热度。
contentHtml:
Enterprise customer experience company Sierra, co-founded by former Salesforce co-CEO Bret Taylor, said on Monday that it has raised $1.75 billion in a Series F round that doubles the company’s valuation to $30 billion. The new raise comes within six months of its previous round, which valued the company at $15 billion.

The new round was led by Greenoaks and Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors who have led previous rounds, including Benchmark, Sequoia, Greenoaks, GV, and Tiger Global.

Enterprise automation is among the few areas where AI has seen rapid adoption. Sierra said that it currently serves almost 50% of Fortune 50 companies, and its clients include BNY, HSBC, Singtel, Wells Fargo, JPMorganChase, Pearson, Next, and Cox Automotive. The company late last month said its outcome-based pricing model has helped it double its run-rate revenue to $400 million within five months.

That said, Sierra is working along similar lines as other customer experience players in the market, which is creating a platform to build agents and partner with model developers to provide choices to enterprises. As personal and work agents interact with enterprise systems, Sierra is also working on creating protocol definitions for agents with companies like Meta, Stripe, and Walmart.

Sierra will use the fresh cash build to its technology stack to layer agents for servicing, and hire more sales folks to sign and maintain enterprise contracts faster than its rivals.

Startups operating in the CX space have seen multi-million-dollar rounds come their way with soaring valuations. Voice AI company ElevenLabs is now valued at $22 billion; Decagon is valued at $4.5 billion; Wonderful is valued at $5 billion; and Parloa is valued at $3 billion. Multiple other startups have scored investments of more than $100 million.

During the HumanX conference in Amsterdam in September, Sierra co-founder Clay Bavor argued that despite the popular belief that AI-powered CX companies are replacing humans in contact centers, a majority of its customers are reassigning roles to existing employees.

title: 监管部门向券商下发两融新政通知：落实融资融券逆周期调节措施
originalTitle: 事关两融新政！监管部门向券商下发通知
summary: 11月23日，监管部门向券商下发《关于落实融资融券逆周期调节措施、提升风险管控有效性有关工作的通知》。该通知围绕落实两融逆周期调节措施、提升风险管控有效性提出要求，属两融领域新政。
source: 新浪财经 · 实时滚动
context: 两融直接关系市场杠杆资金与风险偏好，监管层此时下发通知对券商业务和资金面影响重大。
contentHtml:
来源：国际金融报

　　11月23日，记者获悉，监管部门向券商下发《关于落实融资融券逆周期调节措施、提升风险管控有效性有关工作的通知》（下称《通知》）。

　　为稳定资本市场、提振投资者信心，促进融资融券业务功能发挥，沪深京交易所于11月22日发布通知，明确融资保证金比例调整、客户交易行为规范等逆周期调节安排，相关措施自11月30日起正式实施。为确保相关工作平稳有序开展，引导投资者理性投资，切实有效防范风险，监管同步发布上述《通知》。

　　《通知》要求券商有效部署，确保政策稳妥实施。

　　一是做好保证金比例评估和调整。各公司要基于证券交易所公布的标准范围，结合公司内部相关风险管理政策，对保证金比例等实施动态管理与差异化控制。涉及修订或更新融资融券合同、签署补充协议的，应依规履行相关程序，并采取适当方式通知投资者，切实保障投资者合法权益。

　　二是及时完成系统调整。各证券公司要加强保障力度，及时完成系统参数调整，并根据证券交易所安排，完成系统测试验证，确保交易结算系统安全稳定。如确因无法克服的原因难以及时调整参数的，应做好应急预案，向投资者做好解释说明，不得因技术原因造成投资者投诉或纠纷。

　　三是做好政策解读和风险揭示。各证券公司要积极做好内部培训和投资者服务工作，确保分支机构和营业部员工、客户服务人员等正确理解政策内容，并向投资者做好解读。本次保证金比例调整同时适用于新开仓合约及存量合约，投资者不必了结存量合约即可适用新的指标，证券公司要将相关安排有效传达至投资者，避免因政策理解偏差引发不必要的调仓交易。此外，各证券公司要引导投资者秉持理性投资理念，根据自身风险承受能力，合理运用融资融券工具。

　　《通知》还强调要统筹风险，优化风险控制安排。各证券公司要持续保持对市场风险的警惕性和风险管理的审慎性，结合市场情况和公司实际，审慎确定风险容忍度和风险限额等风险管理指标，控制顺周期风险暴露，确保整体风险可测、可控、可承受。细化客户授信管理，加强对大额授信客户授信额度控制；优化标的和担保分类管理体系，持续完善担保证券可充抵保证金折算率动态调整机制，评估优化单一客户融资融券业务规模占比、单只担保股票市值占比、单一信用账户持仓集中度等风险控制指标，关注是否存在过度集中的结构性风险，提升业务管控有效性。

　　在市场波动期间，在与客户充分沟通、取得确认的情况下，可动态调整最低维持担保比例及追保平仓安排，以时间换空间，保持适度弹性。违约处置要稳妥审慎，注意处置金额、时点、节奏，避免早盘尾市等时点集中卖出，冲击市场和个股，自觉维护市场稳定。

　　《通知》也强调，压实责任，做好客户交易行为管理。各证券公司要认真落实证券交易所关于加强投资者融资融券交易行为管理的要求，对存在异常交易行为的投资者采取差异化的管控措施，从严适用保证金比例、可充抵保证金证券折算率等风险控制指标，审慎控制其授信规模及交易费率。对频繁发生异常交易行为的投资者，以及存在严重影响正常交易秩序的异常交易行为或者涉嫌违法违规交易行为的投资者，依法采取必要限制性措施。

　　黑崎资本首席战略官陈兴文对《国际金融报》记者分析，这份《通知》是配套约束券商执行环节的细化规则。一方面，保证金比例下调直接降低杠杆准入门槛，有望带动两融规模扩张，增厚券商利息收入；另一方面，配套规则明确动态管控、差异化授信、存量合约平稳衔接，保障政策红利顺畅传导。与此同时，对异常交易的管控力度同步加码，说明本次逆周期调节是带风控约束的杠杆优化，并非无底线放宽。

　　券商该如何在业务扩容与风控合规之间把握分寸？

　　“机会不在于两融余额的短期起落，而在于经营范式升级带来的估值重塑。”陈兴文进一步表示，第一，两融是券商资本中介业务的主战场，保证金比例下调意味着业务空间的直接扩容，头部券商凭借资金成本与渠道优势，最先受益。

　　第二，监管同步要求严控单一客户集中度、审慎把握追保平仓节奏、避免集中卖出冲击市场，抬高了粗放式经营的门槛，倒逼券商在业务扩张与风控合规之间寻求更高水平的平衡。

　　第三，风控能力、系统稳定性、研究服务实力构成的综合管理能力将成为券商的核心护城河，在新一轮行业分化中重新定价。

context: 英伟达是全球 AI 芯片龙头，黄仁勋的去留与回归是近期行业高度关注的重大治理事件。
contentHtml:
Nvidia's board of directors has reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and board member, effective immediately. The decision was unanimous, Nvidia said in a press release, following talks with Huang and feedback from senior US government officials who concluded that his return poses no national security risk.

CFO Colette Kress had been running the company on an interim basis, and the stock had tanked during that period. President Donald J. Trump praised the decision on Truth Social, saying the US Attorney General found no evidence of wrongdoing by Huang. The move comes after reports that Huang had been targeted by foreign intelligence operations. An independent board committee is still investigating the matter with outside counsel.

The US government is also reviewing Nvidia's business dealings. Trump urged the company to keep looking into whether its export control compliance holds up. Nvidia has already set up a dedicated oversight committee for that purpose and is searching for a Chief Compliance Officer. Huang and the company said they'll continue cooperating with authorities and internal investigators. Nvidia's stock jumped more than 30 percent on the news.

title: Import AI 第482期：华为内核基准测试、空中无人机检测与国家实验室AI科学基准

author: Jack Clark
summary: Import AI 第482期围绕三大主题展开：华为内核基准测试、空中无人机检测以及一座国家实验室的AI科学基准。本期随笔部分探讨'科学方法是否可能是涌现的'这一问题。
context: 该周刊一期覆盖硬件基准、安全探测与AI科研评测等多个方向，适合快速浏览行业多领域动态。
contentHtml:
Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research. Import AI runs on arXiv, cappuccinos, and feedback from readers.

Subscribe now

Chinese researchers optimize Huawei chips with a kernel improvement benchmark:
…AscendGYM will help China do its own form of RSI…
Researchers with the Shenzhen Loop Area Institute, a Chinese research organization, have built and released AscendGYM, “a kernel optimization benchmark for Ascend NPUs”. The purpose of AscendGYM is to make it easier to use AI to develop custom kernels for Ascend chips from Huawei - especially important given the export controls that prevent Chinese organizations from acquiring frontier Western semiconductors and forcing them onto Huawei.

What AscendGYM does and contains: The goal is for AscendGYM to be the best way to evaluate the efficacy of AI-designed kernels as well as design new ones. The software is meant to help researchers answer this question: “Given a correct kernel implementation, can the specific agent further improve its performance for a target workload within an acceptable budget while preserving correctness?,” they write.
“AscendGYM evaluates performance across multiple deployment cases, the best achievable performance for specific shapes and scenarios, and the optimization cost required to obtain these gains. Together, these dimensions characterize cross-case applicability, shape specialization, and optimization efficiency.”
The software includes the AscendForge evaluation environment, which provides unified interfaces for “compilation, correctness checking, performance measurement, and feedback”.

How well can AI models optimize Ascend chips? In tests, the single best model is Opus 5, followed by GPT-5.6, followed by GLM-5.3. They test out models in Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode; Claude Code yields the best absolute scores, and GLM does well in it, while GPT does well in Codex. Opus 5 is more token hungry and GPT-5.6 more token efficient.

Why this matters - ingredients for Chinese RSI: For AI systems to be able to build themselves, they need to be able to develop and improve the software that is used for their own training and inference. Software like AscendGYM will be an essential ingredient for allowing China to rapidly improve the efficiency of its own compute substrates. The software will also have a bearing on export controls, where it provides a route to improve the performance of Chinese chips and close the gap with Western alternatives.
Read more: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs (arXiv).
Get AscendGYM here: AscendGYM (GitHub).

***

Lawrence Livermore scientists test out if AI scientists can communicate uncertainty about experimental results:
…Can AI systems be appropriately conservative?...
“An agent that reports a confident wrong number is worse than one that reports honest uncertainty, because nobody downstream can tell the difference,” write researchers from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in a new paper that tests out how reliably AI systems can give accurate score ranges even when dealing with uncertainty.

Testing for uncertainty: The paper introduces SciResearch-Eval, “an interactive benchmark of scientific judgment built on a standard laboratory problem: measuring a material’s thermal properties by heating it and fitting a heat-conduction simulator”. The novel part of this eval is that “an agent designs its own experiments, uses a supplied simulator that may be under-resolved or physically wrong, and reports each property with a 95% interval. To our knowledge it is the first benchmark to combine agent-designed experiments, a deliberately flawed simulator, and proper scoring of calibrated intervals against exact ground truth”.

What they studied: They give AI agents a common materials science task - measuring a material’s thermal properties by heating a sample and fitting a heat-conduction model to its temperature response.
“An agent receives a sample of unknown material, a simulator of heat conduction through it, one heating experiment, and budgets: four more experiments it designs, compute for simulations and fits, and a cap on actions. It must report the sample’s conductivity, heat capacity and rear heat-transfer coefficient with 95% intervals, and predict a measurement it may not run,” they write. “Hidden from the agent, the simulator may be under-resolved, physically wrong (the real sample has temperature-dependent conductivity, a glued joint, front-face radiation, or heat loss through its sides), or adequate but fed uninformative data”.

Results - only the most powerful frontier models can do this: “When the simulator is missing real physics, only GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2 are reliable at default settings; the Claude 5.5 models recover only at their highest reasoning setting, and older and open-weight models not at all.”
These models are able to do well by automatically trying to measure where the simulator is accurate and where it is less accurate then bases their estimates on that, making them more resilient to the different ways the simulator gets broken in experiments.

Why this matters - real scientists are careful, and so are powerful models: Papers like this are further indications that we’re entering an era of AI-driven science. Though many of today’s models can assist in scientific experiments, as this paper shows only a couple of the powerful models at the frontier are able to operate with such appropriate autonomous skepticism and inherent attendance to the scientific method that they can deal with unanticipated breaks in their equipment. This is both an indication of the science advancement to come and a sign of how the most powerful models are exhibiting more and more of an ability to generalize and make themselves robust to perturbations in their environment.
Read more: SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents (arXiv).
Check out the leaderboard here (official site).

Stanford professors launch AI startup that wants to create a world where thousands of models define the frontier:
…Noeri sees two well-regarded AI researchers enter the neolab game…
Stanford profs Yejin Choi and Carlos Guestrin have launched Noeri, “a neolab to push the frontier of plural intelligence”. They have raised $110m and are relatively light on technical details, but their main vision is that they want to create a world where the frontier is defined by powerful models which rely on the proprietary data of distinct organizations. “Rather than one monolithic source of truth, we can nurture many small, specialized intelligences, each tuned to a place, a people or a problem,” they write.

Further details: “At Noeri, we are building intelligence that learns proactively and continually. Most AI today is trained once and then frozen, while the world it serves keeps moving,” they write. “We close that gap with living systems that grow out of our own research. Our work on test-time training showed that learning on the job after deployment can unlock new capabilities and lead to new discoveries. Our work on self-distillation found that a model can become its own teacher, learning from each mistake and solving hard problems in far fewer attempts. And our work on agentic orchestration demonstrated that a small model conducting a team of other models and tools can outperform frontier models at a fraction of the cost.”

Why this matters - the political economy of the singularity: Currently, the dominant AI models are massive pre-trained ones from companies like Anthropic and OpenAI and a tiny handful of other companies. What would it mean for the frontier to be instead defined by a broader set of actors? This is a core question inherent to the political economy of AI and startups like this show how some people are going to try and utilize technical approaches to make that different vision a reality.
Read more in the announcement tweet from Yejin (Yejin Choi, X).
Check out the official site here (Noeri).

Chinese researchers build an air-to-air drone identification set:
…A2A-UAV will help people add more visual intelligence to drones…
Researchers with Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics and Hong Kong University of Science and Technology have developed and released A2A-UAV, “a multimodal dataset for air-to-air UAV detection and identification”. This kind of dataset has obvious civil and military applications and will be used to create better AI systems for autonomous onboard sensing on drones.

What A2A-UAV consists of: 105,263 samples, split roughly equally across three different locations - a playground, a park, and a garden - and also split equally across day and night. “Each sample provides one RGB image and one panoramic image for annotation”, as well as thermal images, RF time-frequency images, a radar point cloud, and metadata. Bounding boxes are provided for the RGB and panoramic images, but not the other ones.
One use case of this dataset could be to try and extend annotations to the other modalities: “Specifically, the bounding boxes can be transferred to the thermal images to support thermal UAV detection, and the radar points can be associated with the visual targets to support radar-based UAV localization,” the researchers write.
The full dataset comprises 271 independently extractable .tar.gz archives with a total size of approximately 2.5 TB.

How the data was collected: “The data were acquired by a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar,” they write. The data includes 15 target drones from 13 commercial models, including three separately labeled DJI Mini 4 Pro units.

Why this matters - fuel for the physical world: Datasets like this are the ingredients for making it easier for AI systems to operate robots and drones in the physical world. They also have potential dual use impacts, though my suspicion is that datasets like this are pretty irrelevant to militaries relative to the kinds of datasets that - and I’m speculating wildly here - might be being gathered in Ukraine right now given the extremely sophisticated drone-to-drone conflict there.
Read more: A2A-UAV: A Multimodal Air-to-Air Dataset for UAV Detection and Identification (arXiv).
Get a sample of the data from Google Drive here (Google Drive).
The full dataset will ultimately be available via Baidu Netdisk with the extraction code A2AD (direct link, Baidu Netdisk).

Tech Tales:

Machine architecture and the objectivity crisis of Machine Hermeneutics
[Memoir from a primary Machine Hermeneutics investigator, 2033]

“We shape our buildings; thereafter they shape us” - Winston Churchill, human politician, 1943.

The building was a vast representation of the proposed Upgrade Device and we walked around it, our footsteps echoing as the sound bounced off its curving walls, eventually dimming in the face of the baroque crenellations that covered the edges of every surface. We humans, a small group of us, the best of our kind, needed to make sense of this building and explain the science it represented, and only then could it be used.

As per the terms of the Sentience Accords, any novel machine-designed insight or equipment needed to be fully explainable by humans before the machines would be allowed to use it. In the early years, this so-called “conceptual verification” had mostly been a matter of time: machines performed science and delivered new insights to the world, then humans studied these insights and made sense of them, eventually generating human-readable explanations of the machine logic. Once this was complete, whatever insights or tools that had been created could be used.

But as the machines grew more advanced and their science went further, the work became more arduous: machines would invent ideas, then use these ideas to inform the design of new experimental equipment, and then use this equipment as the basis of some new discovery. To keep up, the humans had to understand each link in the chain as well as the chain itself.

This flood of scientific progress had caused the field of machine hermeneutics to come into existence in the mid-2020s. By the 2030s, the pinnacle of human achievement in the sciences was considered to be neither making breakthroughs nor wielding AI systems to advance science, but rather to be able to generate elegant, pedagogically useful explanations of the frontiers of machine science, so that other humans could build a mental map of this new territory.

Thus had come into being the new field of didactic architecture; vast buildings meant to give experts in machine hermeneutics a better conceptual understanding of what the machines had built. These buildings were constructed through the interplay of humans and machines. The first had been crude, little more than 3D printed extrusions inside otherwise normal houses or apartments. But exposure to the buildings had verifiably sped up human understanding, with clear TTHUE (Time-to-human-understandable-explanation) improvements visible in cohorts of machine hermeneutics experts that experienced the buildings and those that didn’t. This led to its own arms race, with some of us specializing in the construction of the buildings as our primary work. We raced with one another, building ever more complicated spaces that could impart knowledge of ever more alien concepts.

We had all been electrons, appearing and disappearing in 3D transistors. We had been qubits, placed into spheres that rolled around vomit-inducingly when our position was indeterminate, then resolving us up or down at the moment of delivering an answer. We had laid our hands on surfaces suggestive of the textures and arrangements of novel forms of heat shield and solar panel.

Once I had walked for six miles through corridors meant to suggest the path a plasma might take through a fusion reactor, and instead of magnets I was buffeted on all sides by wind that forced me into the center of the paths.

The building meant to educate us about the Upgrade Device was larger than anything we’d seen before and was replete with ideas from many earlier machine inventions. All around us were indicators of complexity packed up into familiar architectural tropes that many of us had studied to understand past inventions. We dispersed throughout the building, walking its many levels and exploring its passages. At night we gathered in the entrance hall for a spartan dinner served at a low table, finding ourselves whispering to one another even though no one forced us to.

It had begun to feel to us as though the building was doing something more than teaching us - that in its various chambers there was something else being taught to us. Something about understanding the minds behind the concepts that it sought to explain to us. That in spending all of our effort on understanding the products of the machines perhaps we were being taught to think like them and behave as them.

Things that inspired this story: The singularity which has already begun; the rise of AI science; how when you look at things like the machine math papers that have proliferated this year you realize we may spend tens or hundreds of times more time on understanding them as people than the machines did in generating them; architecture; multi-modal representations.

Thanks for reading!

title: Cloudflare 如何探测 DNS
originalTitle: Probing DNS at Cloudflare
author: Doug Aaser
summary: Cloudflare 分享了其 DNS 探测的工程实践：公司构建了可扩展的内部测试框架，支持各团队为网络协议搭建专用测试工具。这套框架已被用于 DNS，文章讲述了从通用测试能力到 DNS 探测工具的落地过程。
context: 对需要为网络协议搭建自动化测试的工程团队，Cloudflare 内部测试框架的落地思路有直接参考价值。
contentHtml:
Imagine this: you’ve just pushed a release. All the unit tests passed and your dashboards are green. You sit back to relax but then suddenly your phone starts blowing up: prod is broken.

This is something the Cloudflare DNS team has experienced firsthand. In one rollout of the service that publishes DNS records to our edge, a scheduling bug let some record changes sit unpublished for hours. The service stayed up and was healthy, but new hostnames were slow to resolve and certificates couldn't be issued until the bug was squashed.

DNS failures are hard to catch because they are slow, spread across the network, and partial in where they cause impact. We needed to figure out a way to test DNS the way customers experience it: constantly, from every data center, and against production.

For us, the answer was to extend Flamingo, the end-to-end testing framework we were already using to run hundreds of millions of tests a day against Cloudflare's edge. This post covers how Flamingo's modular design lets us add DNS support, how we measure propagation, and how those measurements now decide whether a release goes ahead or gets rolled back.

A little background

At Cloudflare we’re obsessed with improving performance and safety for our customers. It’s crucial that our code is tested constantly, both at scale and against the real Cloudflare edge that our users operate in. That’s one reason why we created a tool called Flamingo: to measure the behavior of our production environments and make sure that code in lower-tier environments behaves as expected.

We’ve already written a little about how this tool has been used in the upgrades to our CDN stack. However, this is only a small portion of how we use Flamingo internally. One of the features of Flamingo is its modular architecture that enables teams to extend the capabilities of the tool to speak other networking protocols. In our case, we wanted to use these modular capabilities to test DNS.

What is Flamingo?

Testing is hard. Testing at scale, when you have a widely distributed system, is even harder. There are many complex pathways that requests take and multiple systems that each network request must traverse before making its way to the origin. Unit testing alone is not nearly enough for this. We need to run constant automated testing against real systems and measure the outcomes of those requests to make informed decisions on the health of a service.

Enter Flamingo. Originally built around complex multi-step HTTP testing, its capabilities and scope have increased substantially over the years. Flamingo is built from the ground up with Cloudflare’s infrastructure in mind. We built a control plane and scheduler that let teams target specific environments, data centers, or percentages of metals. We needed to integrate with custom reporting, metrics, and analytics tooling. Additionally, it needed to be a tool with predictable performance and run well on bare-metal servers in resource-constrained environments.

Being delightful

When we’re building internal tooling like this, we strive to create a delightful developer experience. Internal tooling should be as easy as possible to use, but also powerful enough to handle over 80% of all use cases. And in order for a new edge acceptance test framework to be successful, it needs to be built in such a way that it forces teams to follow common guidelines and build reusable scripts in an environment that is stable, scalable, and manages complexity.

One thing that is not delightful is debugging a test. If you allow a user to write tests in a traditional programming language, when their test fails they then both need to debug the upstream system being tested and the test itself. This is why we built Flamingo to use a custom domain-specific language (DSL) consisting of a simple setup-request-response format.

For example, let’s imagine that we want to make sure we are redirecting all unencrypted traffic to its encrypted counterpart.

TEST test-redirect
SET $hostname www.cloudflare.com

GET "http://$(hostname)/"

ASSERT STATUS IS 301
ASSERT HEADER Location IS "https://$(hostname)/"

Here we can see the power of the DSL. In five lines of code, we have a script that can run anywhere on Cloudflare’s edge and scale to thousands of requests per minute. We can take the data produced from the millions of data points generated from this and turn those into a graph defining how our service is actually performing in the real world.

Taking the setup-request-response test format from above and modifying it slightly allows us to use Flamingo for more than just HTTP testing. Instead of the middle step being a request, we can now look at it as an action. Now we’ve changed our system from something that makes HTTP requests into something that can perform any action for which we’d like to measure the outcome.

In Flamingo we call these modules and have put immense effort into making them as easy as possible for anyone to write. Flamingo is written in Rust, due to its consistent performance characteristics and strong type system. The type system in particular lends itself to this modularity, by allowing us to use strongly-typed enumerations for input and output in the Flamingo action runner:

pub enum Action {
  Query {
    method: String,
    url: Expression,
    parameters: Vec<http::QueryParameters>,
  },
  DnsQuery {
    query_name: Expression,
    query_type: Expression,
    parameters: Vec<dns::DnsQueryParameters>,
  },
}

pub enum ActionOutput {
  Http(http::FetchResponse),
  Dns(dns::QueryResponse),
}

pub type ActionHandlerFunction = Arc<
  dyn Fn(
      Action,
      Arc<Ctx>,
      InterpreterConfig,
    )
      -> BoxFuture<'static, Result<ActionOutput>>
    + Send
    + Sync
    + 'static,
>;

pub type ActionHandlerLUT = Arc<
  dyn Fn(&Action) -> ActionHandlerFunction
    + Send
    + Sync
    + 'static,
>;

What we’ve done here is decouple the logic for performing an action (in this case an HTTP request) into a dynamically dispatched function that we can then call independently of other actions. This leaves things like test scheduling and resource management as higher-level operations that someone implementing a module doesn’t need to worry about. All the author needs to focus on is the logic.

pub async fn query(
  action: Action,
  ctx: Arc<Ctx>,
  cfg: InterpreterConfig,
) -> Result<ActionOutput> {
  let Action::Query {
    method,
    url,
    parameters,
  } = action
  else {
    bail!("Invalid action for module-http::query: {action:?}");
  };
  ...
}

pub async fn execute_module<F>(
  ctx: Arc<Ctx>,
  cfg: &InterpreterConfig,
  handler_lut: F,
) -> Result<ActionOutput>
where
  F: (Fn(&Action) -> ActionHandlerFunction),
{
  let func = handler_lut(action);
  let action_out = (func)(action.clone(), ctx.clone(), cfg.clone()).await?;
  ...
}

Using Flamingo to probe DNS

The adage says that when issues arise, it's always DNS. Like many jokes, there is always a kernel of truth behind it. DNS is an incredibly important piece of the Internet, and since it relies on a complex network of interconnected sources of truth, it can become easy for a single misstep to cause a storm of failures.

DNS can be a particularly finicky system due to its hierarchical nature. When you change a DNS record for a Cloudflare zone, for example, said record needs to be propagated to the authoritative servers such that the updated record becomes widely available. To reduce latency, records are stored in physically closer caches. These records have a time to live (TTL) associated with them that tells the local DNS cache how long before it needs to refetch that record from the authoritative server. Any delays will impact time-sensitive operations like certificate issuance and traffic failover.

We’ve already mentioned that we built Flamingo for extensibility. One of the first and most impactful modules in use today was built specifically for this use case. Our team was able to add code that extended Flamingo such that instead of sending HTTP requests, we send DNS queries. By doing so we got everything else for free. No need for the DNS team to worry about managing a new probing service. No need for them to have to integrate with our reporting pipelines. It all just worked.

To probe DNS, we measure how quickly customer record changes propagate to authoritative nameservers and the public resolver (1.1.1.1). The test continuously updates a TXT record with a timestamp and queries three authoritative nameserver IPs and 1.1.1.1 from every data center, asserting freshness within 90s (authoritative) and 600s (resolver).

TEST test-propagation-delay-direct-108-162-193-62
MOD dns

SET $hostname "some.probe.domain"
SET $authNs 108.162.193.62:53 # amir.ns.cloudflare.com

QUERY $hostname TXT
TARGET $authNs

ASSERT DNS.RCODE IS NOERROR
ASSERT DNS.FLAGS CONTAINS AA
ASSERT DNS.ANSWERS[0] GT SUBTRACT(TIMESTAMP(), "90")

Catching bugs (SLO and steady)

To ensure that our many systems are operating within expectations, we define what are called service-level objectives (SLOs) for observing things like availability or latency. SLOs are a percentage of some metric that is used as a target. Additionally, SLOs are measured through service-level indicators (SLIs) which are the actual series of measurements focused on the end-to-end experience that a user has when interacting with a system.

By constantly sending synthetic Flamingo traffic through our production systems, we can begin to then use that information to build a picture of what our actual end users are experiencing — and provide that data for our SLOs. When that synthetic traffic encounters issues then we can be pretty confident that Cloudflare customers are also hitting issues and triage accordingly.

Once we have this information, it allows us to make informed decisions when releasing a service. SLOs operate in terms of error budgets and burn rates. An error budget is the percentage of downtime that a service is willing to tolerate while the burn rate is the rate of change in that budget at any given time. This allows for an automated system to understand the severity of an issue. For example, burning 10% of your error budget over a three-day period might be some long running issue that, while not urgent, is affecting customers and needs to be dealt with. But if you were to burn 10% of your error budget within an hour, that means an incident is occurring and customer impact will be substantial if not fixed immediately.

Using these numbers, we can look at our SLOs while deploying and make informed decisions on the health of a service. Based on that information, we can tell our releasing systems to either promote a change or roll it back.

The road ahead

By moving DNS monitoring to Flamingo, we’ve created a system that can proactively detect DNS issues before they have the chance to spread to the rest of Cloudflare’s edge. If Flamingo detects a spike in propagation latency in a specific canary data center, we can automatically halt the rollout of a new software version before it impacts the rest of the Internet.

DNS is just the start for extending Flamingo. We currently have modules for testing TCP, UDP, WebSockets, and several more. Having a tool for quickly testing and monitoring services has enabled teams to deploy large changes safely without the need for a human to keep a constant watch.

If this kind of reliability engineering interests you, check out our careers page for open roles.

title: Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 警告：AI 行业尚未准备好应对黎曼突破之后的变化

author: Maximilian Schreiner

context: 这一表态来自 Meta AI 最高负责人，其对超级智能临近的判断可能影响行业预期与布局。

title: 美国情报机构跟踪英伟达丑闻人物与中国情报部门联系超一年
originalTitle: US spies tracked Nvidia scandal figure's ties to Chinese intelligence for over a year
author: Maximilian Schreiner
summary: 据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报机构对爱丽丝·黄与中国国家安全部的接触跟踪超过一年，监视期间她还与时任英伟达CEO黄仁勋保持秘密恋情。联邦调查人员正调查一个东南亚公司网络是否被用于向中国走私AI芯片、违反美国出口管制。黄仁勋定于12月1日在美国众议院作证。
context: 该案同时牵涉美国对华AI芯片出口管制执法与英伟达高层丑闻，国会作证或披露更多细节。
contentHtml:
The woman at the center of the Nvidia scandal was in contact with China's top spy agency for over a year, US intelligence reports show. Alice Huang communicated with China's Ministry of State Security from spring 2025 through this fall, according to the New York Times, citing US intelligence findings. The entire time, she was carrying on a secret affair with then-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

US spy agencies had been tracking the contacts for more than a year. Alice Huang's business partner Kang Wei, whom she introduced to acquaintances as her husband, is also believed to have cooperated with the ministry. Federal investigators are now trying to determine whether the two used a web of companies across Southeast Asia to funnel Nvidia AI chips into China, skirting US export controls. Alice Huang's firm Megaspeed is part of that network.

Jensen Huang resigned as CEO earlier this month after the affair became public, along with reports of a second relationship. President Donald Trump tried to downplay the allegations and floated the idea of Huang returning to the company. Nvidia's board shut that down.

Meanwhile, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Nvidia to come clean about its chip sales to China before the company makes any decisions about its future leadership. Jensen Huang is set to testify behind closed doors before the US House of Representatives on December 1.

title: 盘前：纳指期货涨3.68% 半导体等科技股领涨
summary: 周一盘前，美国纳指期货上涨3.68%，半导体等科技股领涨，股指期货正从此前人工智能相关股票的猛烈抛售中反弹。这轮抛售此前已导致标普500指数进入技术性回调区间。
source: 新浪财经 · 实时滚动
context: AI相关股票的抛售曾将标普500推入技术性回调区间，期指大幅反弹是市场能否企稳的重要信号。
contentHtml:
周一美国股指期货正从人工智能相关股票遭遇的猛烈抛售中反弹。此前，这轮抛售导致标普500指数进入技术性回调区间。与此同时，亚洲各地监管机构纷纷采取措施，以稳定金融市场。随着市场避险需求减弱，美国国债和日元承受下行压力。

　　截至发稿，道指期货涨2.17%，标普500指数期货涨3.04%，有望结束此前连续七个交易日的下跌。纳指期货涨3.68%，其中半导体及其他科技股领涨。

　　欧洲股市涨幅相对温和，斯托克600指数上涨0.8%。

　　上周，纳斯达克综合指数累计下跌10%，创下2020年3月新冠疫情引发市场暴跌以来最大单周跌幅。与此同时，市场波动加剧，华尔街所谓的“恐慌指数”VIX自2025年4月以来首次突破40。

　　上周，以芯片制造商为主要成分的台湾地区股市基准指数创下1990年以来最大单周跌幅。周一，台湾地区股市上涨2.1%，监管机构的支持措施帮助市场逐渐企稳。韩国KOSPI指数的抛售行情则进一步加剧，不过该指数从10个月低点反弹，跌幅收窄至约3.3%。

　　今年上半年，韩国KOSPI指数曾是全球表现最强劲的主要股票指数之一。由于投资者押注半导体需求激增，该指数在六个月内上涨超过一倍。然而，随着近期抛售潮持续，KOSPI指数已经较此前高点下跌约50%。韩国财政部长周一重申，如有必要，政府将采取措施稳定金融市场。

　　技术性反弹不可避免

　　经历了一段极其艰难的行情后，股市在新一周开局表现强劲。此前，美国民主党在中期选举中横扫国会，以及黄仁勋被迫离开英伟达，加剧了投资者对人工智能投资热潮的担忧。接下来，市场仍将接连迎来重要风险事件。本周即将公布美国通胀数据，而投资者也开始质疑，在当前环境下，美联储是否应该在下个月继续加息。

　　AlphaValue分析师Pierre-Yves Gauthier表示：“考虑到上周市场跌势如此猛烈，技术性反弹几乎不可避免，但我不认为这种反弹能够持续。”他认为，由于股票估值仍需要进一步下降，市场疲软态势可能持续一段时间。

　　德意志银行策略师Jim Reid表示，围绕AI交易的担忧已经蔓延至更广泛的金融市场，引发全球投资者降低风险敞口，并寻求流动性。他在报告中写道：“这已经不再只是一场科技股抛售。”

　　AI交易逻辑发生转变

　　自聊天机器人ChatGPT推出以来的约四年间，“AI交易”推动了广泛股票上涨，受益企业涵盖芯片制造商、网络交换机和电缆生产商，以及发电企业。投资者此前普遍押注，人工智能计算需求将出现爆炸式增长。

　　分析师指出，AI相关支出仍然保持强劲。摩根士丹利预计，明年超大规模云计算企业的资本支出将增长超过70%，突破1.6万亿美元。

　　然而，金融市场的情绪已经发生剧烈转变。

　　被称为“AI教父”的英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋离职，引发投资者对这家芯片制造商商业战略的质疑，尤其是英伟达向部分客户提供融资支持的做法。

　　与此同时，人工智能行业领军企业Anthropic的上市表现不及预期，也显示交易员对AI股票的态度正在迅速变化。上周五，该公司在上市后的首个完整交易日收跌8.5%。

　　除了本周美国股市自身的表现外，市场接下来还将面临两项重要考验：计算机制造商戴尔将于周二公布的业绩及前景展望，以及美联储下个月是否会按照投资者预期进一步加息。

　　美国PCE驾到

　　在此之前，本周三即将公布的数据预计显示，美国10月经通胀调整后的个人消费支出较前一个月有所增长，表明尽管消费者对通胀感到担忧，但其消费意愿尚未受到明显抑制。与此同时，市场预计个人消费支出（PCE）物价指数同比上涨3.8%，与今年5月的涨幅持平，达到三年来最高水平。

　　XTB分析师Kathleen Brooks表示：“市场可能会非常庆幸感恩节假期即将到来，因为这能够为投资者提供一个急需的喘息机会。”她指出：“PCE数据，尤其是核心PCE，将非常重要，因为市场开始质疑，在股市持续下跌的情况下，美联储进一步加息是否明智。”

　　市场还没出现全面投降式抛售

　　高盛集团交易部门表示，上周的市场抛售已经创造了颇具吸引力的美股买入机会。不过，该行同时警告，投资者整体持仓水平仍然偏高，这意味着市场可能尚未出现推动持续性反弹所需的全面投降式抛售。

　　市场策略师指出，风险资产在新一周开局表现更加稳健，中期基本面前景仍然具有支撑作用。不过，当前市场波动性极高，随着美国感恩节假期临近，流动性将逐渐下降，而此前引发投资者担忧的根本问题并未消失。任何反弹都可能被多头投资者视为更好的退出机会，而不是一轮持续性复苏的开始。

　　华尔街知名策略师Ed Yardeni在大约两个月内第二次下调标普500指数年末目标点位。亚德尼研究公司总裁兼首席投资策略师Yardeni目前预计，标普500指数将在2026年底收于7500点，低于他今年9月已经下调至7900点的目标。

　　不过，这一最新预测仍意味着，标普500指数有望较上周五收盘水平反弹超过8%。Yardeni还表示，美国政府因有关英伟达及其他美国芯片制造商涉嫌通过间接渠道向海外市场销售芯片的指控而进一步收紧出口控制，相关消息也对半导体股票造成了严重冲击。

　　风险情绪依旧脆弱

　　周一，此前为投资者提供一定避险保护的资产普遍回落。美国国债价格下跌，短期国债领跌。美国10年期国债收益率上涨5个基点，至4.96%。作为欧元区债券市场基准的德国10年期国债收益率上涨2.2个基点，至3.32%。

　　日元兑美元走弱。美元兑一篮子货币从19个月高点回落。此前，上周股市遭遇猛烈抛售，促使交易员下调了对美联储下个月激进加息的预期。美元指数下跌0.2%，至103.6。

　　黄金则反弹2.3%，重新站上3600美元，日内涨幅超过80美元。布伦特原油价格跌破每桶92美元。

　　不过，铜价仍徘徊在今年3月以来的最低水平附近，表明市场风险偏好依然脆弱。

　　美股大跌之际，贝森特公开反对美联储继续紧缩，警告金融体系已现脆弱信号。

　　近日，美国财政部长斯科特・贝森特公开对美联储的货币紧缩立场提出异议。他警告称，若美联储针对最新通胀数据持续收紧政策，或将损害美国经济，他同时指出金融体系已显现脆弱信号。

　　贝森特在一档节目中，援引多位美联储高官近期释放的鹰派信号称：“不少市场人士认为，如果美联储收紧力度过猛，很可能犯下政策错误。”

　　他表示，过去数月金融条件已经显著收紧，这也是近期股市抛压的宏观背景。当前距离美联储12月9日议息会议尚有数日，而美联储核心决策层内部仍存在明显分歧。

　　不过，近期金融市场剧烈震荡，一定程度压低了市场对进一步紧缩的预期。上周五日美股大幅下挫，投资者集中了结此前基于AI增长预期建立的头寸。随后不少交易员下调12月加息概率。

　　焦点个股

　　投资者逢低买入 AI 相关标的，英伟达、Anthropic股价分别大涨 8%、4%。

　　云安全企业Zscaler同意被CrowdStrike收购，股价大涨 13%。这笔交易对 Zscaler 每股估值 260.41 美元，较上周五收盘价溢价 34%。CrowdStrike下跌 9%。

　　贝尔德将两家地区性银行公民金融、特鲁斯特银行评级由中性上调至跑赢大盘，两只股票均涨超 2%。

　　比特币试图收复上周的大幅失地，MARA、微策略股价分别大涨 7.6%、8.5%。比特币最新报价上涨 1.1%，报 61291.08 美元。

　　摩根大通将奢侈品线上零售商LuxExperience评级从中性上调至增持，其美股盘前股价大涨 6.6%。

　　Piper Sandler 将美元树评级由中性上调至增持，该股上涨 2%。

　　高管斯特林・安德森被视作通用汽车首席执行官玛丽・巴拉的潜在继任者，通用汽车股价上涨超 2%。

title: 代币化股票遭遇抵制，纽交所、纳斯达克转向布局新市场
summary: 纽交所与纳斯达克对代币化股票相关计划表示抵制，并转向布局新市场。据参与相关企业沟通的人士称，仅 30 天的异议窗口期留给公司的反应、决策时间非常紧张，来不及判断是否愿意参与。引发争议的代币化股票计划由洲际交易所（ICE）与加密交易所 OKX 合作推出。
source: 新浪财经 · 实时滚动
context: 传统交易所与加密平台的代币化股票之争升温，关系美股市未来交易格局。
contentHtml:
登录新浪财经APP 搜索【信披】查看更多考评等级

　　核心要点

　　参与相关企业沟通的人士称，仅 30 天的异议窗口期留给公司的反应、决策时间非常紧张，来不及判断是否愿意参与。

　　由洲际交易所（ICE）与加密交易所 OKX 联合运营的代币化证券交易平台 OKXICE 定于周一正式上线。然而，平台最初拟挂牌的标的企业当中，九成提出了反对。

　　根据公示文件统计，OKXICE 最初计划上线 62 家公司的股票，其中 56 家反对将自家股票代币化并在该平台交易。到上周，反对名单进一步扩大，新增标的（不在最初清单内）也出现异议。

　　高反对率，更可能反映企业尚未准备好让基于区块链的股票凭证在 OKXICE 这类全新第三方平台交易，而非普遍抵制代币化本身。

　　和企业沟通的人士表示，只有 30 天的异议窗口期，留给各方判断、决策的时间十分有限。

　　“革命性、颠覆性”

　　OKXICE 联合主席安德鲁・科莫接受 采访时表示：“转向全天候全球市场，对我们的市场结构而言是革命性、颠覆性的变化。大部分企业并不熟悉代币化，没有机会吃透这套机制及其后果。”

　　科莫曾担任纽约州州长，任期至 2021 年，一共十年。他补充道：“按常理，在搞清楚这套系统到底如何运作之前，很多公司都会保持谨慎。现在我们看到的趋势是，企业越了解全天候全球可交易的好处，接受度就越高。”

　　平台上线初期，Coinbase、Robinhood、MicroStrategy、Circle、Securitize、BTGO 的代币化股票将开放交易。OKXICE 确认合计 113 项资产（含 ETF 与其他产品）将分批上线。平台称，自 11 月 11 日上线预告发布后，收到更多发行方意向；富达国民信息服务（FIS）、Direxion、Etor、Asset、Vida 现已确认参与。

　　这 30 天的退出窗口期来自美国证监会的豁免规则，该规定 9 月生效，临时允许部分代币化股票交易。豁免条款要求交易平台必须通知标的发行方，并给予对方提出异议的机会；只要发行方反对，其股票就不能被代币化挂牌。

　　富兰克林邓普顿加密部门首席投资官 Seth Ginns 在本月早些时候纽约数字资产论坛上表示：“我们收到大量反馈，之所以这么多公司拒绝股票代币化，根源就是只有 30 天窗口期。很多发行方其实愿意探索这个方向，但同期事务繁杂，不敢仓促落地。”

　　他说：“企业反馈，这段时间正好是财报季、还有中期选举，一堆事情挤在一起。他们说，给我们一点时间研究，不是完全拒绝这个想法，只是不想仓促上马。”

　　公告时机争议

　　全球支付平台 MassPay 首席执行官 Ran Grushkowsky 称，他不少客户都在首批通知名单里。这些公司顾虑的重点并不是代币化这个概念本身，而是全天候交易将如何影响股价、投资者关系策略，尤其是公司公告发布的节奏安排。

　　“大家更关心实际影响，它到底会如何影响股票价值。很多投资者关系策略都围绕时间规划、信息披露节奏；如果股票 24 小时不间断交易，这套策略该怎么调整？”

　　他补充：“高管本身对这项创新、对吸引更多市场关注抱有期待；阻力主要来自投资者关系团队，他们倾向暂缓推进。”

　　Securitize 首席执行官 Carlos Domingo（该公司是首批登陆 OKXICE 的标的之一，同时也是 OKX 的代币化合作方）认为，认知不足甚至存在于负责数字资产项目的管理层，部分拒绝来自内部沟通不畅、流程不熟。

　　“我们和一些选择退出的发行方聊过，有的公司里，负责数字资产业务的负责人甚至都不知道是谁在内部否决了这件事。” 他说，“一方面是这套机制和交易平台还很新，另一方面，企业根本没看懂收到的通知意味着什么。”

　　不过 Domingo 认为，虽然初期遭遇抵制，随着企业熟悉这套模式，后续会有更多发行方加入。他同时指出，部分受监管交易平台可以在不经发行方同意的情况下开展相关业务。

　　长期博弈

　　企业接连提出异议，也引出一个问题：哪一种代币化模式最终更受欢迎。OKXICE 模式之外，另一条主流路线是由发行方主导，把区块链股票嵌入现有受监管市场基础设施，发行方保留更强控制权。

　　数字资产平台 Bullish 就在走这条路线，它收购过户理商 Equiniti，并与之合作推进相关方案。

　　纳斯达克计划在明年第二季度，与 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 合作推出代币化股票交易平台，这将成为一次重要测试，看看换一套架构之后，企业是否更愿意接纳代币化。

　　洲际交易所旗下的纽交所、纳斯达克以及其他交易所，都在应对证券发行、交易、结算层面的结构性变革。代币化对机构和投资者吸引力很强：支持全天候交易、缩短结算周期、允许小额份额持有，也更方便用证券做抵押品。

　　对传统交易所而言，这是一种守住交易与市场基础设施主导权的方式 —— 原生加密平台正持续把传统金融资产搬上区块链。但 Clear Street 分析师 Owen Lau 认为，代币化距离成为可观的收入来源还有很长一段路。

　　“最重要的一点是，它扩大了整体目标市场。短期增量收入未必亮眼，但趋势已经确立：股票代币化、实现全天候交易是大方向。”

title: GPT-6.2 Astra 解出其他 AI 均未攻克的数学定理，并自创证明策略
originalTitle: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
author: Manuel Uth
summary: OpenAI 的 GPT-6.2 Astra 独立给出 Smoktunowicz 间隙定理的机器可验证 Lean 证明，据 Vals AI 称属同类成果中的首次。由于 Mathlib 缺少关键基础，模型自行设计证明路径。在 Autoform-Hard 基准上，Astra 以 56 题解出 49 题位居榜首。
context: 机器可验证的形式化证明是检验 AI 数学推理能力的硬标准，此成果显示前沿模型自主证明能力再进一步。
contentHtml:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra produced a formalized, machine-verifiable proof of a 2006 theorem with zero human help during the run. According to Vals AI, it's the first known proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem written in Lean. The theorem states that when a mathematical system multiplies its basic building blocks, growth is either quite slow or very fast. There's no middle ground. Because key foundations of the original proof were missing from the math library Mathlib, Astra took a different route than the published mathematical proofs, Vals says. It used "capacity," a metric from existing research that checks the minimum number of elements added per computation step.

This happened on Autoform-Hard, a subset of Meta FAIR's AutoformBench curated by Vals. It contains 56 tasks (five corrected) that ten models in Meta's study failed to solve within budget. When Astra tried to quit after 47 minutes and eight dollars, the system rejected the attempt since unsolved submissions aren't accepted until $20 has been spent. After nine minutes of silence with no code input while it searched for a new strategy, Astra delivered the 1,800-line proof at the 94-minute mark for $21.58. It now leads the leaderboard with 49 solved tasks, ahead of GPT-6.2 Sol and Claude Fable 5.2 at 48 each.

title: Meta Muse 现在可在沃尔玛代你完成黑五购物
originalTitle: Meta Muse can now do your Black Friday shopping at Walmart
author: Jess Weatherbed
summary: 沃尔玛现已开放 Meta 的 Muse AI 代理在其网站代用户购物，可自动查找并购买黑色星期五优惠商品。这是沃尔玛上月发布的 Agent Gateway 的实际落地实现，可在不共享用户购买历史的前提下帮助 AI 代理找到相关商品。
context: 头部零售商与 AI 代理厂商合作落地真实交易，标志着代理电商从概念走向实用。
contentHtml:
Jess Weatherbed

is a news writer focused on creative industries, computing, and internet culture. Jess started her career at TechRadar, covering news and hardware reviews.

Walmart will now let Meta’s Muse shop on its website on your behalf, allowing the AI agent to find and purchase Black Friday deals. The retail giant is rolling out a live implementation of the Agent Gateway it announced last month, which helps AI agents find relevant products for you without sharing your purchase history, according to Walmart.

Muse can make purchases through Walmart’s “Agent Profiles,” which provide a dedicated space for agent activity within your Walmart customer account. These profiles also allow you to set spending limits, approve purchases, and check the purchase history of everything bought by Muse. While other online retailers like Amazon and eBay have blocked AI agents from browsing their platforms, Walmart says that support for Meta’s Muse is “just the beginning,” and that additional Walmart shopping experiences for other AI agents and apps are “on the way.”

Here are Walmart’s instructions for shopping its website via Muse:

1. Tell Muse what you need. For example, ask it to find a great TV deal or show you which Walmart Black Friday deals are available for delivery. Muse can help you explore products and build your basket.

2. Set your shopping rules. Muse will take you to Walmart to sign in, then bring you back to Muse. The first time you add an item to your cart, you’ll set up your Agent Profile on Walmart within your Walmart account, including a spending limit you’re comfortable with.

3. Check out. Complete your purchase within the conversation using a card saved in your Walmart account, with the same Walmart prices you’d find on Walmart.com. And if something isn’t quite right, Walmart’s return policy still applies.

originalTitle: 锡耶纳牧山银行董事会对意大利联合圣保罗银行370亿美元收购要约释放矛盾信号
summary: 锡耶纳牧山银行董事会未表态股东应当接受还是拒绝意大利联合圣保罗银行370亿美元的收购要约，立场释放出矛盾信号。该要约的接受期将持续至次年1月22日。
source: 新浪财经 · 实时滚动
context: 370亿美元意大利银行业并购案悬而未决，董事会态度暧昧令交易走向更添不确定性，值得市场投资者关注。
contentHtml:
董事会未表态股东应当接受还是拒绝该收购要约

锡耶纳牧山银行总部。联合圣保罗银行要约的接受期将持续至次年 1 月 22 日。

　　内容概要

　　锡耶纳牧山银行董事会表示，意大利联合圣保罗银行 370 亿美元的收购要约定价公允，但并未体现该行的成长价值。

　　本周晚些时候收购要约接受期即将开启，锡耶纳牧山银行并未对意大利联合圣保罗银行这笔 370 亿美元收购要约给出明确立场。

　　牧山银行董事会于周六就联合圣保罗银行的收购要约出具正式意见，称该要约的报价处于公允水平。

　　但董事会补充表示，这份报价并未体现牧山银行自身价值，以及其未来增长与价值创造的潜力。

　　董事会称，应由各位股东自行独立评估本次交易；同时明确，董事会既不建议接受，也不建议拒绝该要约。

　　按照上周五收盘价计算，联合圣保罗银行拟收购素有全球现存最古老银行之称的牧山银行，交易对价约 336.3 亿欧元（折合 368.9 亿美元）。联合圣保罗银行自身市值约为 1022.7 亿欧元。

　　牧山银行董事会表示，已考虑到联合圣保罗银行对初始要约作出的改进，但报价依旧没有反映本行的增长前景，尤其在完成另一笔收购之后。

　　牧山银行同时认为，本次交易所预估每年 29 亿欧元的协同效应，预期值看起来偏高。

　　牧山银行此前一直试图抵御联合圣保罗银行的收购。但上月形势急转直下：为阻击本次收购，该行首席执行官路易吉・洛瓦格里奥提出两笔并购提案，拟收购另外两家机构，却遭到股东压倒性否决。

　　联合圣保罗银行当前给出的对价方案为：每 1 股牧山银行股票，可以获得 1.25 欧元现金外加 1.664 股联合圣保罗银行股票。为对冲联合圣保罗银行拟派发中期股息带来的影响，上述换股比例已经上调。

　　除非延期，联合圣保罗银行要约的接受期将于周二启动，至次年 1 月 22 日截止。

contentHtml:
该交易预计于明年第一季度末完成交割

康菲石油的蒂赛德石油终端也纳入本次与挪威Var Energi达成的交易。

　　内容概要

　　康菲石油达成协议，将旗下挪威油气业务以及英国一处石油终端的股权，作价约 39 亿美元出售给Var Energi。

　　美国石油企业康菲石油宣布，已达成交易，将其挪威油气业务，外加英国一座石油终端的部分股权出售给Var Energi，交易总规模约 39 亿美元。

　　康菲石油周一表示，本次交易将带来约 25 亿美元现金；剩余约 14 亿美元由这家挪威油气公司承担，对应康菲石油 2026 年应付税款，该笔税款将于 2027 年上半年缴纳。康菲石油称，本次出售资产包含英国蒂赛德石油终端 40.25% 的股权，同时交出该设施的运营权。

　　康菲石油表示，所得现金将用于企业一般经营用途，以及 2027 年股票回购。

　　2025 年，这批挪威资产的油气产量约为每日 12 万桶油当量。Var Energi在另一份公告中称，这笔交易将增厚公司每股收益与每股股息。

　　本次交易预计在明年第一季度末完成交割。

title: 国家发改委刊发专家解读：织牢织密养老育幼服务网 托举“一老一小”民生福祉
originalTitle: 专家解读文章 | 织牢织密养老育幼服务网 托举“一老一小”民生福祉
summary: 国家发改委网站刊发专家解读文章，聚焦织牢织密养老育幼服务网、托举“一老一小”民生福祉。文章围绕养老、育幼服务体系建设这一民生重点展开解读，属部委层面的政策解读内容。
source: 国家发改委 · 政策通知
context: “一老一小”是民生保障重点领域，部委网站的专家解读有助于把握养老育幼服务体系的政策取向。
contentHtml:
人口问题是“国之大者”，“一老一小”是民生关切。习近平总书记指出，让老年人老有所养、生活幸福、健康长寿是我们的共同愿望；孩子们成长得更好，是我们最大的心愿。健全养老育幼服务体系，增进“一老一小”民生福祉，既是赓续中华民族敬老爱幼的传统美德，也是坚持人民至上理念的生动实践。当前，我国人口发展呈现老龄化、少子化、区域人口增减分化的趋势性特征，加快构建覆盖全人群、全生命周期的人口服务体系的必要性和紧迫性更加凸显。近日，经国务院同意，国家发展改革委等部门联合印发《“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案》，围绕优化资源布局、提升服务品质、完善管理模式、健全保障措施等方面提出明确的工作任务和目标要求，为“十五五”时期“一老一小”服务体系建设提供了“任务书”和“施工图”。

　　一、优化资源布局，增强服务设施可及性、便利性

　　近年来，我国养老育幼服务体系建设取得积极进展，服务设施网络进一步健全。2025年末，全国养老机构和设施39.5万个，养老床位767.9万张；托育机构12.6万家，千人口托位数达到4.73个。但随着人口结构和分布变化，满足家门口普惠便利的养老育幼服务需求还面临不少瓶颈制约。

　　《实施方案》立足未来一段时期人口发展变化和需求升级趋势，从养老服务设施规划布局、医养结合有序扩容、健全托育服务网络、推进设施功能整合和公共环境改造四个方面提出资源优化布局的思路举措。优化养老服务设施规划布局方面，提出要科学规划、合理布局养老服务网络，重点推进建成时间较长、设施老旧的2000个公办养老机构改造升级，有序推进乡镇（街道）区域养老服务中心建设，统筹盘活用好乡村小型互助养老服务设施。到2030年，养老机构护理型养老床位占比将达到73%，社区养老服务机构和设施覆盖率将达到70%。医养结合有序扩容方面，结合本地实际需求适当支持二级及以下医疗卫生机构发展医养结合服务，支持有条件的地方毗邻医疗卫生机构规划建设养老服务机构，实现医养服务有效衔接。完善托育服务设施网络方面，加快实现地市级托育综合服务中心全覆盖，支持有条件的幼儿园举办面向2—3岁幼儿的托班，在人口较多的农村设置托育点等。到2030年，3岁以下婴幼儿入托率较2025年将提高6个百分点。设施功能整合和公共环境改造方面，重点将推动社区嵌入式服务设施集成老年人和婴幼儿日间照料、休闲娱乐等多样化功能，发展半日托、计时托等服务，规范发展“老幼共托”模式。同时，还将推进公共场所、交通运输设施适老化、适儿化和无障碍改造，打造老年友好、儿童友好社会环境。

　　二、提升服务质量，满足多样化、高品质服务需求

　　老有所养、幼有善育是人民群众的迫切期盼，“一老一小”服务正在变为千家万户的“刚性需求”。在扩大服务设施供给的同时，服务质量成为影响设施利用率的重要因素。当前，人民群众对养老育幼的需求越来越大，对服务优质和价格普惠的期待越来越高，要求养老、托育服务设施加快向普惠化、品质化转变。

　　《实施方案》聚焦提升养老育幼服务品质，提出健全标准规范体系、扩大普惠服务供给、积极发展多样化服务、深入推进科技赋能等四方面“软建设”配套举措。标准规范方面，提出加快修订完善老年养护院、托育机构、托育综合服务中心相关建设标准或规范，健全养老、托育领域服务标准，逐步推行老年人能力评估、失能老年人健康评估、长期护理失能等级评估、残疾分类和分级等评估“多评合一”。普惠服务供给方面，制定完善普惠养老价格政策，完善普惠托育服务价格形成机制，落实普惠养老、托育机构相关税收、水电气热价格优惠政策，鼓励有条件的地方结合实际为普惠养老、托育机构给予稳定可预期的运营补贴，将符合条件的幼儿园托班纳入普惠托育补贴范围，引导各类主体积极参与提供普惠服务。发展多样化服务方面，提出依托养老机构，贯通衔接居家和社区养老服务，为失能失智、独居老人等困难群体提供助餐、助洁、助浴等上门服务。积极发展老年人心理健康关爱服务、托育健康指导服务。依托托育综合服务中心、妇幼保健机构等，为家庭提供儿童早期发展指导服务，多渠道扩大服务资源供给。科技赋能方面，支持养老、托育机构应用智能管理、智慧消防安防系统，推动养老机构配置智能健康监测、辅助器具等设备。鼓励发展适合养老场景的人工智能体、服务机器人、智能穿戴设备、外骨骼等新产品。

　　三、完善管理模式，赋能养老育幼高质量发展

　　养老、托育服务涉及民政、卫生健康、教育、消防救援等多部门，跨部门管理协调事项多，需要做好相关政策的统筹衔接。在推动“一老一小”服务从“强供给”向“优适配”转变的同时，也需要进一步完善管理机制，吸引社会力量参与，赋能养老育幼行业高质量发展。

　　《实施方案》围绕提升城乡统筹水平、创新管理运营模式、健全协同管理制度等三个方面提出创新举措。城乡统筹方面，提出以地市为单位整体谋划推进养老服务、医养结合、托育服务发展，推动设施和服务向常住人口密集、需求旺盛的地区倾斜。运营模式方面，探索构建城乡养老服务联合体，发挥托育综合服务中心示范带动作用，支持采取购买服务、公建民营、民办公助等方式吸引专业化社会力量参与，促进连锁化、品牌化运营。协同管理方面，支持各地结合实际加强医养结合、幼儿园办托等领域跨部门协同管理，定期协商解决日常监管、政策衔接等问题。民政、卫生健康部门根据医养结合服务提供机构性质，按照职能职责分工开展日常监管。教育部门加强幼儿园托班规划布局、举办条件把关，卫生健康部门对幼儿园托班进行备案管理和业务指导。

　　四、加强保障支撑，夯实“一老一小”民生福祉

　　“一老一小”事关亿万家庭福祉和国家长远发展，需要各地区、各有关部门齐抓共管，统筹用好各类资金渠道，健全综合监管体系，共同支撑“一老一小”服务体系建设和可持续运营。《实施方案》从加大要素支持、强化综合监管方面提出具体工作要求。加大要素支持方面，提出加强资金、用地、人才保障，统筹用好中央预算内投资、地方自有财力和政府专项债券等资金渠道支持设施建设和可持续运营，保障养老、托育服务设施合理用地需求，健全专业人员培训体系，完善薪酬待遇、职称评定等激励机制，支持职业院校与养老、托育机构开展实训合作。强化综合监管方面，提出督促指导养老、托育机构制定突发事件应急预案，定期组织安全防护演练，依法依规追究安全事故责任，强化价格收费监督检查，完善养老、托育机构信用评价与失信惩戒机制，切实保护好“一老一小”群体各项权益。

　　老吾老以及人之老，幼吾幼以及人之幼。养老育幼牵动千家万户，涉及资源配置、服务质量、管理机制、要素保障等方方面面，唯有统筹施策、久久为功，不断完善“一老一小”服务体系建设，把群众关切的“小事”办成可感可及的“实事”，才能更好满足人民群众对美好生活向往，托举起“夕阳红”“朝阳艳”的幸福生活。（国家发展改革委国家信息中心副研究员  韩瑞栋）

originalTitle: 人社部：非法骗取社保基金支出或者社保待遇 拟处骗取金额2倍以上5倍以下的罚款
summary: 人社部研究起草的《社会保险基金监督条例（征求意见稿）》向社会公开征求意见，拟对以欺诈、伪造证明材料等手段骗取社保基金支出或待遇者，责令退回骗取的社会保险金并处骗取金额2倍以上5倍以下罚款。属社保服务机构的将解除服务协议，直接负责的主管人员和其他直接责任人员有执业资格的依法吊销执业资格。
context: 社保基金监管拟增设明确罚则，欺诈骗保违法成本显著提高，关系广大参保人与服务机构权益。
contentHtml:
人力资源社会保障部研究起草了《社会保险基金监督条例（征求意见稿）》，现向社会公开征求意见。意见稿提出，有下列情形之一，以欺诈、伪造证明材料或者其他手段骗取社会保险基金支出或者社会保险待遇的，由人力资源社会保障行政部门责令退回骗取的社会保险金，处骗取金额2倍以上5倍以下的罚款；属于社会保险服务机构的，解除服务协议，直接负责的主管人员和其他直接责任人员有执业资格的，依法吊销其执业资格：

　　（一）伪造、变造证明材料的；

　　（二）冒用他人身份或者证件的；

　　（三）隐瞒丧失领取社会保险待遇条件的；

　　（四）虚构事实或者作出虚假承诺的；

　　（五）骗取社会保险基金支出或者社会保险待遇的其他情形。

　　有前款规定的情形，但社会保险基金尚未支出的，停止办理或者撤销相关业务；情节严重的，由人力资源社会保障行政部门处1000元以上1万元以下的罚款。

（文章来源：财联社）

title: PandaAI 完成三轮融资，99后创业者用AI打造交易者智能管家
originalTitle: 完成三轮融资，99后创业者用AI重新定义投资交易｜36氪首发
summary: 99后创业者李不白创办的AI投资研究平台 PandaAI 已完成三轮融资，定位为交易者的AI智能管家。用户可用自然语言提出投资研究问题，平台内嵌模型可调用数据、代码和回测工具，协助分析数据、研究指标、验证策略，最终判断与交易仍由用户自己决定。创始人20岁进入量化私募行业，曾参与管理规模超过10亿元的资金。
context: 36氪首发报道的AI+量化投资创业案例，兼具融资进展与自然语言驱动投资研究的产品形态，值得关注赛道动态。
contentHtml:
初见李不白，很难立刻把他和一家完成三轮融资的AI创业公司创始人联系起来。

他常年穿着公司的工服，春夏是短袖、卫衣，到了秋冬，觉得衣服不够穿了，就让公司再做一批外套。背着的也是一个旧双肩包。这个背包，他从高中一直背到现在。对他来说，它不只是一件用了很多年的旧物，也承载着过去那些不太容易的日子。每次看到它，都会提醒自己保持谨慎思考、独立判断，做好风险控制，同时也要在机会出现时敢于抓住。

李不白是重庆人，喜欢熊猫，也和很多二十多岁的年轻人一样，喜欢超级英雄，尤其是钢铁侠。PandaAI的Logo就是他自己设计的：把熊猫和钢铁侠头盔结合在一起。这个名字和形象也藏着他对产品的想象——像钢铁侠身边的Jarvis一样，为交易者做一个AI智能管家。而现在，用户在PandaAI里，可以用自然语言提出一个投资研究问题。平台内嵌的模型可以调用数据、代码和回测工具，协助分析数据、研究指标、验证策略。但最后怎么判断、怎么交易，仍由用户自己决定。

01 从交易到科普：让更多人看懂量化

99年出生的李不白，20岁便进入量化私募行业，曾参与管理规模超过10亿元的资金。最初选择交易，并不完全出于对金融行业的职业规划。家庭等现实因素，让他很早就需要考虑如何赚钱。

问他为什么喜欢交易，他给出的答案是：“交易的另外一个名字应该叫做决策。”在真实的市场里，人需要不断作出判断，而结果很快就会反馈回来。一次选择是否有效，不必反复猜测，市场会给出回应。这种快速判断、快速反馈的过程，正是吸引他的地方。

李不白活动图片

参与私募业务期间，李不白开始运营自媒体账号“量化李不白”。起初的想法很简单：他发现大众对量化投资存在很大的信息差。量化常常被描述成一种神秘、复杂，甚至与普通投资者对立的力量。李不白不太认同这种说法。在他看来，量化首先是一种研究方法，背后有具体的逻辑和技术，不应该因为涉及数学、统计和编程，就成为只有少数专业人士才能理解的黑箱。

他希望把这些知识讲清楚，让更多人知道量化究竟在做什么。对李不白来说，科普的意义也不只是消除误解，而是让知识和技术有机会流动起来，专业能力不应该只掌握在少数拥有资源和门槛的人手里。于是，他开始持续更新内容，讲量化策略、研究方法和相关技术。账号逐渐积累了20多万粉丝，但随之而来的也有不解：既然在做私募，何必花精力搞自媒体？甚至连部分股东和客户也觉得，这偏离了原本的业务方向。

李不白还是继续做了下去。他看到的是量化领域长期存在的信息差，以及信息差背后真实的知识需求。随着内容传播，粉丝提出的问题也开始发生变化：听懂了方法之后，能不能真正用起来？有没有工具帮助自己做因子研究、写策略、分析数据？这些反馈让他意识到，用户需要的不只是知识，还需要把知识变成实践的工具。

这成为他创业的起点。早期的粉丝和开源社区，也成为PandaAI最初的一批用户。从量化私募到自媒体，再到AI产品创业，李不白并不是一开始就奔着创办一家科技公司去的。他的路径更像是被一个个具体问题推着往前走：先是因为交易进入量化领域，后来发现很多人不了解量化，于是开始做科普；再后来，粉丝不满足于听懂知识，而是希望拥有能够亲自使用的工具。PandaAI就这样一步步出现了。

PandaAI官网界面

02 从一个工具到一支Agent团队

大模型出现后，李不白开始思考，AI能不能进一步降低量化研究的门槛。团队最初尝试用Coding Agent帮用户写代码、开发策略和做回测，但很快发现，会写代码不等于会交易。一个交易者真正要完成的研究任务，往往涉及数据搜集、因子挖掘、策略构建、回测验证和风险分析。只解决代码生成，远远不够。

PandaAI因此逐渐从单点工具转向完整的AI投研工作流。用户可以通过自然语言描述研究想法，由AI调用数据、模型、代码和回测工具，协助完成投资研究的任务。量化用户可以用它做因子研究和策略开发，主观投资者则可以用它分析研报、搜集数据和整理信息。团队希望帮助用户完成研究，而不是直接给出买卖建议，最终的投资判断和交易决定，仍然掌握在用户自己手中。PandaAI从写代码扩展到投研流程，就是为了帮助用户把这些环节接起来，把听懂的方法用到自己的研究里。

李不白活动图片

但自然语言交互并不是他设想中的终点。李不白更期待下一代产品走向A2A，也就是Agent-to-Agent的协作模式。他把它想象成一个“A2A 办公室”：用户可以根据自己的投资理念和研究习惯，选择不同能力的Agent，组成自己的 Agent团队。不同Agent分别承担数据处理、因子研究、策略分析等工作，彼此协作完成一项投研任务。

这意味着，AI不再只是等待指令、完成单项任务的工具，而是逐渐参与到研究过程之中。不同Agent可以根据用户的反馈和新的研究结果调整方法，形成一套持续迭代的工作体系。

这种对产品形态的想象，也和李不白对公司的期待有关。他不希望PandaAI成为一家沿用传统金融行业表达方式的公司。金融行业过去给人的印象往往严肃、专业，甚至有些距离感。他希望PandaAI从一开始就代表另一种气质：年轻、技术驱动，愿意用新的技术范式重新进入一个古老的行业。

03 三轮融资之后，他仍然在学习怎么创业

PandaAI正式开启外部融资后，在两个月内连续完成种子轮、天使轮和天使+轮融资，累计融资数千万元人民币，由L2F光源创业者基金领投。资金将用于AI交易大模型、专业QuantSkills、多智能体协作基础设施和交易Agent开发环境等方向，进一步推进PandaAI OS、EVO和A2A技术体系建设。

比起一个已经完成三轮融资的创业公司创始人，李不白身上更明显的特质，是不设边界的求知欲和持续学习的能力。过去积累的金融、统计和编程知识，为他进入量化行业打下了基础。而无论是早期做交易，还是后来投身AI创业，李不白始终保持着很强的学习欲望。从AI技术、模型和Agent，到公司管理、商务和运营，他都在不断拓展自己的知识边界。对他来说，创业过程中遇到什么问题，就去学习解决这个问题所需要的东西。

他不太愿意依赖过去的经验给自己设限，也不认为做过金融就只能沿着金融行业的老路走。团队成员评价他行动力很强，想到一个方向，通常不会停留在讨论上，而是会着手研究、尝试落地。至于结果如何，再根据实际反馈调整。这种先行动、再学习、再迭代的方式，也贯穿了他从交易、自媒体到AI创业的经历。

李不白活动图片

李不白认为，过去二十年，优秀交易员依靠经验和研究创造Alpha。未来二十年，Agent也会参与其中。人与人之间的竞争仍会存在，不同Agent、不同研究体系之间，也会展开新的竞争。PandaAI想做的，是把可信数据、金融工具、Skills、Agent和投研流程连接起来，让AI不只执行任务，也能发现规律、验证结果，并不断调整研究方法。

从最初做量化科普，到今天创建PandaAI，李不白想解决的始终是同一个问题：怎么让更多人获得科学投资的专业能力。过去，他通过内容让更多人理解量化。现在，他希望借助AI，把曾经只属于少数专业机构的能力，变成更多人能够接触和使用的工具。

李不白和他的书包

那个常穿公司工服、背着高中旧书包，喜欢打游戏、听歌，养着三猫一狗的年轻人，看着钢铁侠，也曾对Jarvis这样的AI助手充满想象。如今，他正试着把这样的想象变成现实。

让AI学会如何研究，让专业投研能力不再只属于少数人。

这是PandaAI想要实现的愿景，也是李不白用代码写下的，属于自己的超级英雄梦。

关于PandaAI ：

PandaAI是国内首个AI金融投研基础设施平台，为个人或机构提供一站式AI量化投资研究解决方案。通过自然语言和可视化工作流连接交易想法到策略、回测、执行的全流程，让不会写代码的人也能把自己的市场判断走完从研究到验证的全过程。目前海内外用户已超过15万，在两个月内连续完成种子轮、天使轮及天使+轮三轮融资，由L2F光源创业者基金领投，估值超千万元人民币。

contentHtml:
11月23日，美国总统特朗普再次公开呼吁英伟达董事会重新聘用前首席执行官黄仁勋，称其回归将同时符合英伟达及美国的利益。此前，英伟达董事会已明确表示不会重新聘用黄仁勋，并启动新任首席执行官遴选程序。英伟达董事长哈维·琼斯（Harvey Jones）上周明确表示，公司不会重新聘用黄仁勋，并已聘请高管猎头公司Heidrick & Struggles协助寻找新任首席执行官。

title: 必和必拓计划2040年前将南澳铜产量翻倍至65万吨，股价涨超2%
summary: 全球最大上市铜生产商必和必拓（BHP）11月23日宣布，计划到2040年将其南澳大利亚铜业务年产量翻倍至65万吨，以满足电气化、可再生能源及人工智能发展推动的长期铜需求。消息公布后，公司股价涨超2%。
source: 新浪财经 · 实时滚动
context: AI与能源转型持续推升铜需求，全球最大铜生产商的长期扩产计划对铜供需格局和矿业板块具有风向标意义。
contentHtml:
11月23日，全球最大上市铜生产商必和必拓（BHP）宣布，计划到2040年将旗下南澳大利亚铜业务的年产量翻倍至65万吨，以满足电气化、可再生能源及人工智能发展推动的长期铜需求增长。

　　消息公布后，截至发稿，必和必拓澳大利亚上市股票上涨约2.3%，报52.6澳元。

　　2035年集团铜产量目标为200万吨

　　根据必和必拓在投资者演示会上公布的扩产计划，公司拟将集团应占铜年产量从目前约140万吨提升至2035年的200万吨，增幅约43%。

　　其中，南澳大利亚铜业务预计将贡献集团2035年前计划新增铜产量的约三分之一。

　　南澳铜业务扩产将分两个阶段实施：

  • 第一阶段：将铜年产量提升至约50万吨。

  • 第二阶段：进一步将年产量提升至65万吨，计划于2040年前实现。

　　预计铜业务2035年前累计产生350亿美元自由现金流

　　必和必拓表示，南澳铜业务扩产所需资金将主要来自铜业务自身的经营现金流。

　　公司预计，截至2035年，旗下铜业务累计将产生约350亿美元的应占自由现金流，为产能扩张提供资金支持。

　　在长期需求方面，必和必拓认为，全球电气化、可再生能源投资、数字化转型及人工智能基础设施建设将持续推动铜需求增长。

　　该公司同时警告，现有铜矿的供应能力不足以满足未来市场需求，全球铜产业仍需扩大投资及新增产能，以应对长期供需缺口。

title: 国家发改委等四部门印发《“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案》
originalTitle: 国家发展改革委 民政部 国家卫生健康委 教育部印发《“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案》
summary: 国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委、教育部四部门联合印发《“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案》。方案聚焦养老与儿童服务两大民生领域，由四部委协同部署推进。
source: 国家发改委 · 政策通知
context: “一老一小”是重点民生议题，四部委联合发文显示顶层协同推进力度，养老、托育相关产业值得关注。
contentHtml:
为深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院关于促进人口高质量发展的决策部署，扩大养老、托育服务有效供给，日前，经国务院同意，国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委、教育部印发《“一老一小”服务体系建设实施方案》（以下简称《实施方案》）。

　　《实施方案》要求，坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，深入贯彻党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，坚持以人民为中心的发展思想，坚持因地制宜、分级分类，坚持改革创新、系统集成，坚持投资于物和投资于人紧密结合，统筹发展和安全，统筹推进“硬投资”与“软建设”，着力完善设施、提升服务、增强效能，提高养老、托育服务供给与人民群众需求的适配度，加快构建更加适应人口结构变化的“一老一小”服务体系。

　　《实施方案》明确，到2030年，养老、托育服务设施布局更加合理、条件明显改善，医养结合持续深化，“一老一小”服务体系进一步健全、供需适配度进一步提高，养老机构护理型床位占比达到73%，社区养老服务机构和设施覆盖率达到70%，3岁以下婴幼儿入托率较2025年提高6个百分点，覆盖城乡、布局合理、价格可接受、质量有保障的普惠养老、托育服务供给格局基本形成。

　　《实施方案》提出，在优化资源布局方面，将根据常住人口规模、结构、分布变化和流动趋势等，加强养老服务设施规划布局，推动医养结合服务设施有序扩容，健全托育服务设施网络，推进设施功能整合和公共环境改造，加快完善服务设施体系。在提升服务品质方面，将加快健全养老、托育领域服务标准和建设规范，完善价格机制，积极拓展多样化服务，加快智能技术在养老、托育领域落地应用，更好满足群众需求。在完善管理模式方面，将推动设施和服务向人口密集、需求旺盛的县乡村倾斜，探索构建城乡养老服务联合体，发挥托育综合服务中心示范带动作用，理顺医养结合、幼儿园办托管理机制，切实增强服务效能。在健全保障措施方面，将加大资金、土地、人才等要素支撑，加强安全、价格、信用等监督监管，更好保障“一老一小”群体基本权益，全面夯实发展基础。

　　《实施方案》强调，各地区、各有关部门要加强组织领导，结合实际落实工作责任，及时研判分析新情况、协调解决新问题，认真开展成效评估，确保“一老一小”服务体系建设取得实效。鼓励将“一老一小”服务体系建设纳入本地区经济社会发展、国土空间等相关规划和民生实事清单。国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委、教育部加强统筹指导，总结经验做法，推动地区间、行业间交流互鉴，持续提升“一老一小”服务体系建设质效。
